# Clinical Practice

This folder contains topics related to the standardized monitoring, follow-up routines, and guideline adherence for patients with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) and related conditions in the Danish registry. The included page details how biomarkers like fecal calprotectin are used to track disease activity and outlines specific institutional protocols, such as the annual systematic follow-ups recommended for patients with primary sclerosing cholangitis (PSC).

## Pages

- [[clinical-practice|Clinical Practice]] — Details standardized monitoring, biomarker tracking like fecal calprotectin, and institutional follow-up routines for IBD and PSC patients within the Danish registry.
